_comment: The MCP registration `shinobi agent` writes for Claude Code, kept here as a reference for what the launcher does on your behalf. You do not need to merge it by hand: `shinobi agent` calls `claude mcp add --scope user` for you, using the same server resolution `shinobi llm` uses, and leaves an existing registration alone. Pass --no-wire-mcp if you would rather configure the server yourself, or `shinobi mcp register claude` to do it outside a launch. shinobi agent exports SHINOBI_ENGAGEMENT / SHINOBI_ENGAGEMENTS_DIR before starting the agent, so the server inherits them — no extra env config needed. SHINOBI_ENGAGEMENTS_DIR is the engagements root; a per-engagement path is not accepted.
